summary.abstract: Pseudonymised GP records for 412,000 adults registered with practices in Westmoor, covering diagnoses, symptom scores and prescriptions for common mental health conditions, linked to community pharmacy dispensing and maternity services records.
summary.description: Coded entries from the GP record are extracted monthly. Depression and anxiety are identified from SNOMED CT code lists maintained by the partnership. Maternity services records are linked for women with a recorded pregnancy.
summary.shortTitle: Westmoor Primary Care Mental Health Linked Dataset
summary.title: Westmoor Primary Care Mental Health Linked Dataset

origin.collectionSituation: Primary care - Clinic;,;Prescribing - Community pharmacy;,;Secondary care - In-patients

access.accessService: Data are only available in the Westmoor secure data environment, after approval by the partnership's independent data access panel.
access.accessRequestCost: High cost: charges cover data extraction, linkage and secure environment hosting.

followUpSchedule.note: Records are refreshed monthly from participating practices.

eligibility.inclusionCriteria: Adults aged 18 or over registered with a participating Westmoor general practice at any time since 2010.
eligibility.exclusionCriteria: Patients who have registered a national data opt-out.
